LanguageData.Raven_Ability_Kotoamatsukami.label: (Raven) Kotoamatsukami
LanguageData.Raven_Ability_Kotoamatsukami.description:
An extremely rare illusion technique. It can infiltrate the target's mind without being detected and rewrite their will.

On allies: forms an absolute master-servant bond.
On enemies/neutrals: erases memories, forces them to join your colony, and rewrites beliefs.

Cooldown: 60 days (1 year).
